mainEntity.name: What is call center outsourcing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Call center outsourcing means assigning telephone-based work to an external team. That work may be inbound or outbound. Cypher Digital focuses on outbound lead follow-up, qualification and sales-support calls, with outcomes returned to your team in a structured Excel sheet.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between inbound and outbound call centers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Inbound teams receive customer calls for enquiries or support. Outbound teams make planned calls to a supplied list for lead follow-up, qualification, sales support or feedback. Our current packages are for outbound calling.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a call center and BPO?

acceptedAnswer.text: A call center focuses on telephone communication. BPO is broader and can include call center operations as well as finance, data processing, HR, IT support and other back-office work. Cypher Digital provides a focused outbound calling service, not a full BPO operation.

mainEntity.name: Do you provide inbound customer support or a 24/7 helpdesk?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Our current service is outbound lead calling and follow-up. The packages on this page do not include an inbound customer-service line, complaint desk, technical-support desk or 24/7 helpdesk.

mainEntity.name: Do you provide call recordings?

acceptedAnswer.text: No call recordings are promised with these packages. We record the call outcome in your lead sheet, including answer status, interest level, notes and follow-up details where applicable.

mainEntity.name: Is this different from a traditional call center?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A traditional call center usually handles inbound customer service, technical support or complaints. We focus on outbound lead follow-up and lead qualification: calling the leads your marketing generates and returning a qualified list to your sales team.

mainEntity.name: What does lead qualification mean?

acceptedAnswer.text: We ask each lead a few questions you agree with us in advance, such as their requirement, timeline and budget range, then tag them hot, warm or cold so your team knows who to call first.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer telemarketing and appointment setting?

acceptedAnswer.text: We run outbound calling to your own lead lists and, where you need it, note a preferred callback or meeting time for your sales team. We don't call bought or scraped lists.

mainEntity.name: Is this a call center outsourcing service?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We are a focused call center outsourcing service in Sri Lanka that specialises in one high-value task: the first call and sales follow-up on your leads. Instead of setting up a full outsourced call center, you get exactly the part most businesses struggle with, fast and consistent first contact and follow-up, without the cost, staff or software of a traditional call center.

mainEntity.name: What exactly is your lead calling service?

acceptedAnswer.text: You send us the leads you get from your Facebook, Google or landing-page campaigns, and we make the first call to every one of them. We record who answered, who's interested and who to skip, then give you a clean, formatted Excel sheet with follow-ups ready, so your sales team only works the leads worth working.

mainEntity.name: How do I send you my leads, and what do I get back?

acceptedAnswer.text: Just send your lead list as an Excel file or export (name and phone number is enough). We call each lead and return a properly formatted Excel sheet showing who answered, interest level (hot, warm or cold), notes, and follow-up dates, ready for your team to work.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a phone system or software?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. You don't need any dialer, CRM or phone system. We do all the calling on our side and simply hand you a clean Excel file. It works with the tools you already use.

mainEntity.name: How much does the lead calling service cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Packages are priced by lead volume: Starter (up to 100 leads) from LKR 15,000 per month, Growth (up to 300) LKR 35,000, Pro (up to 600) LKR 60,000, and Custom (1,000+) from LKR 90,000. One-off lists can also be priced separately.

mainEntity.name: What happens if a lead doesn't answer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Depending on your package we make up to 2 to 3 call attempts before marking a lead as no-answer. Every outcome, answered, no answer or wrong number, is recorded in your Excel sheet.

mainEntity.name: How fast do you deliver the called list?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most lead batches are turned around within a few working days, and Growth, Pro and Custom packages include regular weekly, twice-weekly or daily delivery so your team always has fresh, called leads to follow up.

mainEntity.name: Do you work with Facebook and Google lead ads?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We work with leads from Facebook and Instagram lead ads, Google forms, landing pages and any CRM export. As long as we have a name and phone number, we can call and clean the list.

mainEntity.name: Will you use our script and speak in our brand's name?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Before we start, we agree on a short script and exactly how you'd like your business introduced, so every call sounds like it's coming from your company, not a random call center. You stay in control of the message; we handle the dialling and the volume.

mainEntity.name: Can you call leads in Sinhala, Tamil and English?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our callers handle Sinhala, Tamil and English, so each lead is spoken to in the language they're most comfortable with. In Sri Lanka this noticeably improves both answer rates and how willing leads are to share what they want.

mainEntity.name: Is my lead data kept private and secure?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Your lead lists are confidential, used only to make your calls, and never shared, resold or reused for anyone else. We are happy to sign a simple NDA before you send us any data.

mainEntity.name: Do I get only the warm leads, or the whole list back?

acceptedAnswer.text: You get the whole list back, every lead with its call status, with the hot and warm leads clearly flagged at the top. Nothing is hidden; you keep full visibility and ownership of all your data.

mainEntity.name: Can this work alongside our existing sales team and CRM?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We are the first-call layer that feeds your existing team, not a replacement for it. Import the finished Excel straight into your CRM, or let your reps work from the sheet as-is. Your closers pick up where our first call leaves off.
